name: post-carousel
title: Post carousel
description: A post with pictures to swipe through: the one in view swings out and tucks in behind while the next comes forward.

props.name: slides
props.description: One picture per slide. An img or an SVG fills the frame edge to edge.

props.name: label
props.description: Read by screen readers, e.g. “Post by Ada Lovelace”.

props.name: header
props.description: The row above the pictures, e.g. an avatar and a name.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The picture in view at first, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called when the post heads for a new picture: on release, a key or a button.
